multiOsVm.title: Multi-OS Embedded Virtual Machine
multiOsVm.desc:
Type-1 Hypervisor written in advanced Rust language, designed for resource-constrained embedded systems, supporting parallel operation of multiple OS virtual machines while ensuring real-time performance of VMs themselves, isolation between VMs, and overall system reliability.
Reliability: Using Rust as the programming language, leveraging its inherent safety features to improve code quality and ensure system software reliability at the language level.
Isolation: System resources are isolated from four aspects: CPU, interrupts, devices, and memory, ensuring VMs cannot access resources belonging to other VMs.
Real-time: Through interrupt passthrough mechanism and mediated pass-through device mechanism, effectively reducing the impact of virtualization on real-time performance.
features: Multi-OS parallel operation with efficient resource isolation
Support for real-time and general-purpose OS hybrid deployment
Embedded virtualization technology with low overhead and high security
Flexible system switching and hot-plug capabilities
Support for multiple mainstream industrial protocols and interfaces
